cases.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN (%s, %s, %s) AND o.created_at >= %s AND o.created_at < %s GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.product_name FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN (%s, %s, %s) AND o.created_at >= %s AND o.created_at < %s GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.order_status IN (%s, %s, %s) AND r.region_name = %s AND o.created_at >= %s AND o.created_at < %s LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id=r.region_id WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND o.created_at >= '2030-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2031-01-01' AND o.order_status IN ('completed','shipped','refunded') GROUP BY 1
